_about: AI cost configuration (M2 slice 7; models filled in M3 slice 7a). Prices are integer micro-USD per million tokens, verified on Anthropic's own models and pricing pages on 2026-10-12 (see each pricing_status); re-verify before relying on them later. Code never contains prices or model IDs: the ledger, the cap and the adapters read them only from this file. api_key_env is the NAME of a server-only environment variable (its value lives only in apps/web/.env.local and is never committed, read by Claude, printed or logged).
